titulo.estudio: Læsning 2 · Fortæller og perspektiv i prosa
titulo.alumno: A limited perspective · Narrator and perspective in prose

intro: Part 2: a limited perspective. Notice which form expresses the relationship and go back to the sentence to check it.

texto: In prose, separate who narrates from who perceives. A scene may leave out explanations and let the reader infer a motive from gestures, references and changes of tense.
Notice which form expresses the relationship and go back to the sentence to check it.
